name: Spec-Gaussian
definition: A method that utilizes anisotropic spherical Gaussians to approximate 3D scene appearance to handle complex shading like specular and anisotropic components.
summary: Spec-Gaussian approximates complex 3D scene appearance by using Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians to model specular and anisotropic shading, distinguishing itself from standard isotropic Gaussian Splatting.
